Create ONE NEW COMPLETE CHARACTER wearing his full coherent armor, helmet and boots, holding ONE sword. Do not make an empty garment or a collage of separate pieces.
Subject: a charismatic heroic late-sixteenth-century Joseon admiral in his forties, an ORIGINAL face and not a real actor, calm fierce eyes, neat black moustache and a short pointed chin beard. Tall, lean heroic anatomy with powerful broad shoulders and a substantial chest; physical head excluding the helmet is only one eighth-and-a-half of his sole-to-skull height. Keep a genuinely small proportionate head, never oversized. Upright neutral spine and level neck, no backward lean.
He wears generously cut, THICK and broad-shouldered muted oxblood-red Joseon dujeong armor with realistic woven fabric over hidden steel plates, an evenly spaced regular grid of small aged brass rivets, dark almost-black leather bindings, substantial overlapping shoulder guards and full sleeves. The coat has one STRAIGHT vertical center-front closure, a clean central slit below the hips, two straight long skirt panels ending slightly below the knees. Plain dark trousers and exactly TWO tall dark leather boots below the armor hem.
Pose: strict symmetrical T-pose. Both upper arms and forearms extend straight horizontally to his sides at shoulder height. His LEFT fist (viewer RIGHT) is empty. His RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT) grips exactly ONE beautiful practical hwando sword with the handle passing THROUGH his closed fingers, thumb wrapped around the grip, a small brass guard above the fist, a dark wrapped handle and a modestly curved clean steel blade. The blade points UP AND AWAY from his body toward the upper-left of the image, nearly vertical with a slight outward lean; it never crosses or touches his torso, head, sleeves or boots. Keep this sword attached in the correct hand, no floating weapon, no second sword, no scabbard. The arm itself stays horizontal in a T pose even though the blade points upward.
Composition: square 1254x1254 canvas. Exact orthographic straight FRONT view, eye-level neutral product camera, no 3/4 angle and no dramatic perspective. Show the complete helmet, both fists, the ENTIRE sword including its tip, all armor panels and both complete boot soles, with a clean margin around everything. Adjust framing to fit the raised blade and T-pose without cutting off any object. Soft flat even studio lighting, neutral light-grey seamless background, no floor line, no cast shadows, natural material colors with clean PBR-readable detail. Photorealistic premium game character production reference, no painterly or toy-plastic look.
Exactly ONE person and ONE sword. No background objects, no stand, no labels, no text, no logos, no border, no diagram, no multiple views.
